versions.description: Best first. Version 1 is the single line you would post for the writer, checked against the rules before you write it. Version 2 is optional: a genuinely different honest move. At most 3. When unchanged is true: exactly one, the line exactly as written.

line.description: The sharpened first line. One line, no line breaks.

why.description: One plain sentence of at most 140 characters, true for this version. Quotes only words in the writer's line or this version.

unchanged.description: true only when the line is already sharp and comes back exactly as written.
